scientific_integrity: Analytic proof with supplementary finite checks; prior Cesaro membership in the full Toeplitz algebra is credited to Sang (2026). Numerical checks are not treated as infinite-dimensional evidence.
scientific_limitations: Periodically row-weighted discrete Cesaro matrices on complex ell2 only; not arbitrary almost-periodic rows or other lp spaces. The distance formula specifies an infimum and finite-rank-corrected approximants, not existence or uniqueness of an exact nearest algebra element. Specialist priority uncertainty remains.
title: Exact Toeplitz-algebra distances for periodically modulated Cesàro operators
